name: CMOS hysteretic Schmitt trigger
description: A six-MOS feedback inverter stack and two output inverters form a ten-MOS inverting Schmitt trigger. Complementary feedback changes the switching threshold according to the current state. A slow 0-to-3.3-to-0 V input ramp measures rising-input and falling-input thresholds and verifies the rail states. The two thresholds demonstrate nominal hysteresis. Generic Level-1 educational models; noise immunity, metastability, propagation delay and PVT limits are not qualified.
